OKR and KPI Tracking
Software for Aligned Teams.

Connect company, team, and individual goals in one structured system.

The problem

Company goals set in Q1.
Forgotten by Q2.

Most teams define OKRs at the start of the quarter, then track progress in scattered spreadsheets, skip check-ins, and lose alignment within weeks.

and execution cadence.

Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about QuikScale — from OKR setup to KPI tracking to how check-ins and reviews work.

What is OKR and KPI tracking software?−
It's a platform that connects your company strategy to team execution. You set OKRs (objectives and key results), define KPIs for each goal, and track progress in real time — replacing spreadsheets and scattered goal documents with one structured system.
What is the difference between OKRs and KPIs in QuikScale?+
OKRs define what you want to achieve and why — objectives with measurable key results. KPIs are the ongoing metrics that show how you're performing. QuikScale lets you set both and link them so your teams track the right numbers against the right goals.
What is Weekly Wins and Work (WWW)?+
WWW is a structured weekly update format where each team member captures their wins, planned work, and any blockers. It replaces ad-hoc status updates with a consistent rhythm — so managers have full visibility without constant check-in meetings.
How do meeting rhythms work?+
QuikScale includes built-in cadences for weekly check-ins, monthly reviews, and quarterly goal reviews. Each meeting type has a structured format with agenda items, decision tracking, and action items — so reviews actually happen and follow-throughs don't get lost.
Can I track goals across multiple teams?+
Yes. QuikScale gives you a cross-team goal view that shows every department's OKRs, KPI progress, and check-in status from one dashboard. Leadership can spot alignment gaps without chasing individual team updates.
How does goal ownership work?+
Every goal, KPI, and priority in QuikScale is assigned to a specific owner. Owners receive check-in reminders and progress update prompts, and are accountable for keeping their goals on track — with full visibility for their manager.
Is QuikScale only for leadership or can individual contributors use it?+
Both. Leadership uses QuikScale to set company OKRs and view cross-team performance. Individual contributors use it to see their personal goals, log weekly wins and work, and understand how their efforts connect to company objectives.
Is QuikScale part of the Quikit platform?+
Yes. QuikScale is one of 11 connected apps in the Quikit platform. Goal data links directly to QuikTrack for task-level execution, QuikCRM for revenue targets, and QuikSocial for team communication — so strategy and delivery stay connected.
